$comment: sentinel-hook — project hooks, committed. Every session in this repository (live, scheduled, subagent) runs scripts/sentinel/sentinel.mjs: a heartbeat on SessionStart and SubagentStart, and a deterministic allow/ask/deny on every Bash, Write, Edit, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit and Read call before it runs. The record goes to research/sentinel/ledger/ at the nearest .git (override with VIGILIA_SENTINEL_LEDGER_DIR). Keep this file and scripts/sentinel/ out of every agent's write scope.
